summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that the Supreme Court of New South Wales approved convening of scheme meetings and dispatch of a scheme booklet for its proposed redomiciliation from Australia to the United States. Under the schemes of arrangement, newly formed US Holdco (Nova Minerals Corp, Nevada) will acquire all issued ordinary shares and listed warrants; shareholders will receive US Holdco shares or CDIs, and warrant holders will receive new warrants. The independent expert concluded the schemes are in the best interests of shareholders and warrantholders, and the board unanimously recommends a vote in favor. Scheme meetings are set for May 29, 2026. This is a corporate re-domestication rather than a standard special-situation category. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and completion of the redomiciliation process.
